backlog.spec: Single country fills with color on a world/region SVG map, animates from transparent. Label + value callout. Source label.

2-4 countries light up on map with value labels beside each. Sequential or simultaneous reveal. Color encodes value.
Regions fill with color intensity mapped to data value. Legend bottom-left with gradient scale. Source label.
Multiple city dots appear on map with labels, radiating pulse on each. Staggered reveal. Category label.
Region grows from one year to another (empire expansion, market spread). Year label updates. Before/after visual.
Two-line name + title bar, slides in from left, holds, slides out. Dark bg strip, cream text. News-standard.
Bottom-strip attribution: 'Source: IMF 2024' with subtle fade in/out. Small caps, muted. Non-intrusive.
Rectangular callout card with key stat or definition. Appears mid-screen, bounded container, holds for N frames. Terracotta accent top.
City + country tag with pin icon. Journalism-style. Slides in bottom-left, holds, fades.
In-scene chapter label in lower third (not full-screen). 'Chapter 2: The Mechanism' style. Terracotta accent bar.
Wider card with name, credential line, small headshot placeholder. Slides in from bottom.
Animated arrow draws to target point with label box at tail. Arrow head + shaft animate. Terracotta line.
Circle draws around a region. SVG circle with dasharray animation. Optional label connected by leader line.
Portion of frame zooms in with border, PiP-style. Full frame stays at 0.3 opacity behind. Bounded container.
Bracket wraps a section with a label. SVG bracket draws in. Label reveals after bracket completes.
Pulsing dot + line connecting to floating label. Targets specific coordinates. Good for annotating images/screenshots.
Red/terracotta rectangle draws around a frame region. Investigative-document style. Draws in 2 passes (top+bottom, then sides).
Digit wheels roll up to final number, mechanical odometer style. Each digit column scrolls independently. Landing click.
Number counts from 0 to final value with easeOutExpo curve. Fast start, decelerating landing. Label below.
Airport departures-board flip animation. Each character flips through options before landing. Mechanical feel.
Horizontal scrolling ticker tape, stock-market style. Multiple key=value pairs scroll continuously left.
Shows a change: '+12.4M' with up/down arrow. Delta value animates in with color (green up, red down). Before/after.
2-3 counters in a row counting simultaneously. Each with label. Staggered start. Good for 'Deaths / Displaced / Cost'.
Numbered steps left-to-right with connecting arrows. Each step reveals with content. Arrow draws between. 3-6 steps.
Chain of boxes with trigger animations between them. Domino reveal — each box causes the next. Terracotta connecting lines.
Wide-to-narrow funnel with stages and drop-off numbers. Each stage narrows with percentage label. Spring physics on narrowing.
Tree structure builds root-down. Lines draw between nodes. Labels reveal per node. 2-3 levels deep.
Circular process with 3-5 nodes. Arrows connect in a loop. Each node highlights as the cycle progresses.
Single input splits into two outcomes. Decision tree fork. Left path vs right path with labels and values.

Single anchor object remains central while 3-4 mutation chips appear around it with connector lines. Use for mechanism or policy explanation where one object persists and only one property changes per beat.
One token travels across a simple multi-step path while node cards explain each checkpoint. Use for systems, pipelines, and mechanism explanations where the viewer should track a payload.
Horizontal scrolling timeline with event markers. Camera pans along. Events pop up with cards as timeline reaches them.
Hard vertical line wipes across frame revealing 'after' from 'before'. Draggable-slider aesthetic. Year labels on each side.
Events stack vertically, each fading in as virtual scroll advances. Date left, content right. Alternating accent colors.
Period on timeline highlights and zooms. Background dims except the era. Date range label. Content card appears.
Two parallel timelines advancing together. 'Policy' track vs 'Outcome' track. Events on each track connected by vertical lines.
Animated noise grain texture overlay at adjustable opacity. Period/analog feel. SVG noise filter or canvas.
Black bars slide from top/bottom to crop to 2.39:1. Cinematic mode activation. Content reframes within bars.
Ken Burns + depth layers. Foreground element moves faster than background. Creates 3D depth from 2D image.
Slow vignette darkens/lightens at edges. Tension breathing effect. Radial gradient overlay animates.
Tint wash transitions warm to cold (or reverse). CSS filter hue-rotate + saturate animation. Signals temporal shift.
Webpage inside browser chrome frame with URL bar. Content scrolls or highlights. Rounded window, realistic shadow.
Smartphone frame with content inside. Can show tweet, app UI, or article. Device bezel, rounded corners, notch.

Monospace terminal text types itself out character by character. Green-on-dark or amber-on-dark. Cursor blink.
Twitter/X style post card: avatar placeholder, username, quote text, engagement numbers. Bounded container.
Dark-stage product or thesis spotlight with a central feature card, sparse support chips, and connective lines. Use as contrast punctuation rather than a default scene type.
Grid of company/country logos fades in. Can highlight subset or gray out others. 4x3 or 3x3 grid. Staggered reveal.
Numbered ranked list builds from #1 down (or bottom up). Each entry slides in with value bar. Staggered reveal.
Ranked rows that can reorder with animated transitions. Bar-race adjacent. Position swaps animate smoothly.
Horizontal row of 4-6 brand logos with value labels beneath each. Staggered fade-in. Category label above.
Country flags in a grid. Specific ones highlight in color, rest gray. Good for 'G7 nations' or 'BRICS members'.

Full subtitle lines appear/disappear bottom-third. Clean, accessible. Background strip for contrast. Timed to sentences.
